summary: Baiya International Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a share purchase agreement dated June 8, 2026, to sell 100% of its wholly-owned subsidiary Juxing Investment Group (Hong Kong) Limited to Shengshi International Group Inc. for $2,000,000 aggregate cash consideration. Juxing indirectly controls Shenzhen Gongwuyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd through VIEs. The board approved the disposition on June 8, 2026, under a general mandate from shareholders at an EGM on February 9, 2026. Closing expected within one month, subject to customary conditions. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing timeline risks.
